component.name: Arrow Browser
component.summary: Fast, private web browser that blocks ads and trackers

description.p: Arrow is a small, fast web browser for Linux that keeps your browsing to yourself. It blocks ads and trackers out of the box, runs well on older computers, and collects no personal data.

ul.li: Ad, tracker and pop-up blocking, with cookie banners and empty ad boxes hidden
Clean links: tracking tags such as utm_ and fbclid are removed before pages load
HTTPS whenever a site supports it, and Global Privacy Control sent to every site
Warnings for fake bank and payment sites, and for pages that copy a command for you to paste
Per-site controls under the padlock: ads, JavaScript, pop-ups, zoom, permissions and cookies
Fingerprint protection: third-party cookies blocked, canvas and audio fingerprints disguised
Passwords kept in your system keyring, filled only when you click
Sleeping tabs, Tab Memory and a Low Memory Mode for older PCs
Digital Wellbeing: screen time, daily site limits, break reminders and bedtime mode
Light and dark themes, search shortcuts, pausable downloads and private windows

description.p: Arrow is built on WebKit. Sites that need DRM (Netflix, Spotify and similar) don't play, and there are no extensions or sync.

screenshot.caption: Browsing with ads and trackers blocked

ul.li: Pages with videos use less memory and data: videos load the way the site asks
Hiding cookie banners is now off by default, as it uses memory on every page; turn it on in Settings, Privacy
First release on Flathub
The mouse wheel and touchpad scroll sites that froze scrolling, such as mindrift.ai
File pickers use your desktop's own file chooser
Global Privacy Control tells every site not to sell or share your data
Link-click pings to trackers are blocked
Cleaner, matching toolbar icons and a real shield button
Links clicked inside a page get HTTPS and lose their tracking tags too
The fake bank site warning also checks clicked links and redirects
Many smaller fixes to downloads, pop-ups and block lists
Warnings for fake bank and payment sites, and for pages that copy a command
Optional SponsorBlock for YouTube
Privacy settings regrouped
